sentence_stem: It was not until the end of the meeting that
correct_completion: the director finally explained the plan.
full_sentence: It was not until the end of the meeting that the director finally explained the plan.
acceptable_variants: the director explained the plan clearly.
the plan was finally explained by the director.

options.why_wrong: The subject and object are reversed. The director explains the plan, not the other way round.
English word order requires the subject before the verb, so the subject 'the director' must come first.

options.text: in the afternoon, the plan was lost.
options.why_wrong: This changes the meaning completely and does not complete the emphatic 'it was not until... that' structure.

options.text: the director finally explained the plan.

grammar_focus: Emphatic cleft structure with 'It was not until... that'
explanation: The structure 'It was not until... that' places emphasis on the time when an action finally happened. The clause after 'that' must be a complete clause with a subject and a verb.
translation: Só no fim da reunião é que o diretor finalmente explicou o plano.
